QA Higher Education works in partnership with Southampton Solent University to deliver a range of programmes for foundation to undergraduate level.
Foundation year: prepare for undergraduate study and bring your current qualifications up to undergraduate level

exams: UCAS tariff points / A-Levels / IB for UG

scholarships.name: Solent EU Welcome Scholarship
scholarships.description: Fee discount for EU nationals on UG courses, reducing fees to £10,500/year. Automatic upon application for September 2026 entry.

scholarships.name: Contextual Offer Scholarship
scholarships.description: One-off scholarship for first-year UG who receive a contextual offer from Solent. 150 awards for 2026/27, first-come-first-served.

scholarships.name: Students of Colour Scholarship
scholarships.description: £1,000 credit to Solent University catering account for first-year UG from under-represented ethnic backgrounds.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
scholarships.description: PG scholarship scheme for international students from Commonwealth nations. Supports MA-level study at Solent.

scholarships.name: Alumni Discount
scholarships.description: 20% reduction of PG tuition fees for Solent University graduates returning to study. No restriction on graduation year.

scholarships.name: Care Leavers Bursary
scholarships.description: Bursary of £1,500 for first-year UG care leavers. Means-tested support.

scholarships.name: Carers Bursary
scholarships.description: Bursary of £1,200 for UG who are carers for dependent family members.

accommodation.name: Kimber
accommodation.text: En-suite superior комнаты, ближайшая резиденция к main campus. Виды на парк. 274 спальни, общие зоны с мультимедиа, парковка, прачечная.

accommodation.name: David Moxon
accommodation.text: En-suite комнаты для первокурсников UG, часть интегрированного комплекса. Флэты по году обучения, тихие зоны, удобное расположение.

accommodation.name: Deanery
accommodation.text: En-suite study-bedrooms в отдельных флэтах для UG и PG. Жильё для maritime officer cadets и exchange students. Центр Саутгемптона.

accommodation.name: Chantry
accommodation.text: Бюджетная опция, 208 спален. Большой общий зал, Marsh Lane. Самая доступная резиденция; en-suite по запросу.

campuses.title: East Park Terrace Campus (Main)
campuses.text: Главный кампус в центре Саутгемптона. UG + PG преподавание по engineering, maritime, creative industries, sport, business. Пешком до магазинов и развлечений.

campuses.title: Warsash Maritime Academy
campuses.text: Специализированный maritime-кампус. Крупнейший в UK ship & port simulation centre, dedicated fire training school, engineering workshops, единственный в стране manned model ship handling centre на Timsbury Lake.

campuses.title: London Centres
campuses.text: QA Higher Education partnership centres в Лондоне (Fitzwilliam House, St James House, Rosebery Avenue) — UG и PG программы, вечерние и weekend занятия.

paragraphs: Southampton Solent University — современный специализированный университет на южном побережье UK. Основан как университет в 2005 году.

Лидер в практическом, industry-connected образовании: maritime (Warsash Maritime Academy — один из топ-центров в мире), sport (топ-10 национально), music & sound production (9 студий, партнёрства с Abbey Road), fashion, film, journalism, computing/games.

Уникальное оборудование: единственный в UK manned model ship handling centre, 60-метровый hydrodynamic towing tank, industry-standard recording studios, virtual production stage (Disney/Mandalorian-технология).
QA Higher Education партнёрство открывает pathway: International Foundation, International Year One, Pre-Master's программы — в UK + London.
